raw.details:
How to take part (two steps):

  1. Register here on Unstop. This is step one.
  2. Complete your registration at https://hackathon.homingo.co.in/?utm_source=unstop&utm_medium=listing&utm_campaign=hackdays. Your dashboard, your team and your project submission are on that site, so registering on Unstop alone is not enough to take part.

Homingo Hack Days is an online AI hackathon, open to participants across India. Entry is free. The idea is simple: ship something that works. You get two weeks to take a project from idea to a public repository and a short demo video.

Who can join: anyone in India. Take part solo or in a team of 2-4.

Tracks: Agents, Automation, LLM apps. AI tools are allowed, so use the stack you would use on a real project.

Timeline

  • Registration closes: 15 Nov 2026, 11:59 PM IST
  • Build phase: 21 Nov - 6 Dec 2026
  • Submission deadline: 6 Dec 2026, 11:59 PM IST
  • What to submit: a public GitHub repository and a short demo video (a live link is optional)

Prizes

  • Rs 5,000 to the winner
  • Recommendation certificates for the top 3
  • A certificate for everyone who submits

The whole event runs online.

Organiser: Homingo

Questions: official@homingo.co.in
